title: Implement an autocomplete
body:
As of now we can't implement an autocomplete menu with InstantSearch.js. This would be practical as we wouldn't need an other library for implementing a webpage with both an instant search page and an autocomplete menu.

Let's try to devise an API for implementing this use case. For example, if we take the autocomplete as a whole widget, the connector should be able to: 
 - `refine` the query
 - let the user define other sources (other configurations, with the same or a different index)

This may not be the right approach though, and we should first try to implement an autocomplete with the minimal API design (aka PoCs) and move on from what we learn doing them.

Steps towards:
 - [ ] PoC with an existing autocomplete
 - [ ] PoC from scratch
 - [ ] API
 - [ ] Implementation
